name: Recommender Systems (collaborative filtering)
when_to_use: User-item interaction history (purchase, rating, click); suggest items to a user based on what similar users preferred.
notes: Suggests items to a user based on what similar users liked. Applications: product/content recommendation.

expected_input.question: What to recommend to a user, based on what similar users preferred?

plain_explanation.purpose: Suggests items to a person based on what similar people chose.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there is a history of who consumed what and you want to suggest the next item.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Table with the person's identifier, the item's and, if available, the rating given.
plain_explanation.example: Suggest products to a customer based on what similar customers bought.
plain_explanation.diagram: you ~ similar people -> what they liked and you have not seen yet
